problem.diagnosis: The frozen reliability selector is structurally a market-argmax selector followed by SELECT/ABSTAIN. It is not a full H/D/A reclassifier. In the frozen reliability model, Draw reliability does not reach the 0.55 selector threshold, so Draw cannot enter the selected sample under this frozen structure.

interpretation: V6.50.9 is a high-risk H/A abstention filter, not a Draw solution and not a full 1X2 model.
